title: Invoices ignore the customer's currency
requirement: Every invoice is rendered in USD even for customers billed in EUR or GBP. Customer already has a currency field. format_money in billing/money.py always prints a dollar sign; it should take the currency code and print the right symbol ($ for USD, € for EUR, £ for GBP, and the code followed by a space for anything else, e.g. 'JPY 1,000.00'). Invoice.render in billing/invoice.py and the receipt line in billing/receipt.py must pass the customer's currency through. Keep the existing two-decimal, comma-grouped format.
acceptance: invoices and receipts use the customer's currency
unknown codes print as the code and a space
